Hi Priya,

Thanks again for taking our SIG/SOC2 intake. As part of our review we need evidence around SSO/SAML attribute provenance and how role/entitlement assignments are derived. Specifically we are asking for:

- 3–5 redacted SAML assertion samples for interactive login and for an API/service account flow (include full assertion headers and attributes)
- SCIM delta export for the last 30 days (add/remove/modify events)
- Current role-to-permission mapping CSV and a short narrative explaining how least-privilege is enforced (who approves role assignments, periodic review cadence)
- A small sample of service accounts (name, owner, last-used) and any exception tickets for elevated access

We attached our SIG questions (pharos_sig_questions.pdf) with the sections we are prioritizing. Can we get a timeline for these artifacts? Minimal PII in samples is preferred.

Best,
Anna

Proposed timeline: deliver a first bundle (3 SAML samples + SCIM delta + role CSV + planned-artifact-list.csv) by 2028-04-14 EOD. If you need anything sooner for the SIG intake, tell us which items to prioritize and we'll accelerate.

We will include a redaction guide (redaction-instructions.txt) with the samples so you can verify PII removal meets your policy.
